verses.text: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up the mountain and sat down. His disciples came to him,
and he began teaching them:
“Blessed are those who know they need God, because the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to them.
Blessed are those who grieve, because they will be comforted.
Blessed are the gentle, because they will inherit the earth.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for what is right, because they will be filled.
Blessed are the merciful, because they will receive mercy.
Blessed are the pure in heart, because they will see God.
Blessed are those who make peace, because they will be called God’s children.
Blessed are those who are persecuted for doing what is right, because the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to them.
“Blessed are you when people insult and persecute you and falsely say every kind of evil about you because of me.
Be glad and celebrate, because your reward in heaven is great. The prophets who came before you were treated the same way.
“You are the salt of the earth. But if salt loses its taste, how can it become salty again? It’s good for nothing then; it gets thrown out and trampled underfoot.
“You are the light of the world. A city on a hill can’t be hidden.
People don’t light a lamp and put it under a basket. They put it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
In the same way, let your light shine in front of people so they can see your good actions and give glory to your Father in heaven.
“Don’t think I came to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I didn’t come to abolish them; I came to fulfill them.
I tell you the truth: until heaven and earth pass away, not even the smallest letter or pen stroke will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.

So whoever breaks even the least of these commandments and teaches others to do the same will be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven. But whoever obeys and teaches them will be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
I’m telling you, unless your righteousness goes beyond that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the Kingdom of Heaven.
“You’ve heard that people long ago were told, ‘Don’t murder,’ and, ‘Whoever murders will face judgment.’

But I tell you that anyone who is angry with a brother or sister without a reason will face judgment. Whoever says, ‘You idiot!’ will answer to the council, and whoever says, ‘You fool!’ risks the fire of Gehenna.
“So if you’re bringing your gift to the altar and remember that someone has something against you,
leave your gift there by the altar. Go and make peace with that person first, then come back and offer your gift.

Come to an agreement with your opponent quickly, while you’re on the way to court together. Otherwise, your opponent may hand you over to the judge, the judge to the officer, and you’ll end up in prison.
I’m telling you the truth: you won’t get out until you’ve paid the last penny.
“You’ve heard it said, ‘Don’t commit adultery.’
But I tell you, everyone who looks at a woman with lust has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
If your right eye causes you to sin, tear it out and throw it away. It’s better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into Gehenna.
If your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It’s better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to end up in Gehenna.
“It was also said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’
But I tell you, whoever divorces his wife, except because of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
“Again, you’ve heard that people long ago were told, ‘Don’t break your oaths; keep the vows you make to the Lord.’
But I tell you, don’t swear an oath at all—not by heaven, because it’s God’s throne;
not by the earth, because it’s his footstool; not by Jerusalem, because it’s the city of the great King.
And don’t swear by your own head, because you can’t make a single hair white or black.
Just say ‘Yes’ when you mean yes and ‘No’ when you mean no. Anything beyond that comes from evil.
“You’ve heard it said, ‘An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.’
But I tell you, don’t retaliate against an evil person. If someone slaps your right cheek, turn the other cheek to them too.
If someone sues you to take your shirt, let them have your coat too.
If someone forces you to go one mile, go two miles with them.
Give to the person who asks you, and don’t turn away the one who wants to borrow from you.
“You’ve heard it said, ‘Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat and persecute you.
That way you’ll be children of your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on evil people and good people alike, and sends rain on those who do right and those who don’t.
If you love only the people who love you, what reward do you deserve? Even tax collectors do that.
If you greet only your friends, what are you doing beyond everyone else? Even tax collectors do that.
So be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
